왜 이 제품인가

  • 루테인

1일 1회1회 2캡슐물과 함께

루테인 표시량(12mg/1200mg)의 80~120%
비타민 D 표시량(25μg/1200mg)의 80~180%

Health Functional FoodLutein 12mgVitamin D 25μgVitamin E 11mgOmega-3 560mgOnce a day

루테인오메가3DLutein · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Omega-3

Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장 · Once a day · 2 capsules

This product combines 12mg of Lutein, 25μg of Vitamin D, 11mg of Vitamin E, 560mg of Omega-3 as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 capsules): 12mg Lutein, 25μg Vitamin D, 11mg Vitamin E, 560mg Omega-3
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 광동헬스바이오(주) 2공장

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help with maintaining macular pigment density (which can decline with age) for eye health
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Omega-3
    • May help with improving blood triglyceride levels and improving blood circulation

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 capsules per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Lutein labelled (12mg / 1200mg), 80~120%
Vitamin D labelled (25μg / 1200mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (11mg / 1200mg), 80~150%
Omega-3 labelled (560mg / 1200mg), 80~120%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미·이취가 없는 빨간 주황색의 점성이 있는 내용물을 함유한 어두운 갈색의 타원형 연질캡슐
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월
Storage 직사광선을 피하고 서늘한 곳에 보관 및 유통(실온)

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Lutein · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Omega-3 together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

  • Made by (주)알피바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Lutein
    • May help with maintaining macular pigment density (which can decline with age) for eye health
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Omega-3
    • May help with improving blood triglyceride levels, improving blood circulation, and improving dry eyes for eye health
